plain: Fair, with no personal stake in the outcome

webster.text: Uninterested; indifferent; free from self-interest; having no personal interest or private advantage in a question or affair.

example.quote: A general opinion must pervade the community, that the house, the body to impeach them for misconduct, is disinterested, and ever watchful for the public good; and that the judges who shall try impeachments, will not feel a shadow of biass.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XIII, Jan. 14, 1788
